name: Menna

While his tribal affiliation is not specified, his presence in this lineage highlights his role in the ancestral line leading to Jesus Christ. familyAndRelationships: Menna is identified as the son of Melea and the father of Mattatha, as stated explicitly or inferred in Luke 3:31. Scripture does not provide any other family relationships for Menna beyond these.
